newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oji Paper falls on glum earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Oji Paper falls on glum earnings report.

text.p: Oji Paper Co Ltd shares fell in early Tuesday trade, depressed by media reports about glum earnings, brokers said.
As of 0056 GMT, the shares were down eight yen at 613.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Tuesday that it expected Oji's 1997/98 earnings to decline due to falling paper prices and increased depreciation costs related to new plant and equipment.
The newspaper said Oji's parent current profit in the year to March 31, 1998, was expected to be 23 billion yen, down sharply from its estimated profit for 1996/97.
The company was not immediately available for comment on the report.
Oji said in October that its parent current profit in 1996/97 would be 48 billion yen, little changed from its actual parent current profit of 48.07 billion yen in 1995/96.
